label: scam
text: Dear customer, your SBI account will be blocked today. Update KYC immediately at http://sbi-kyc-update.example/login and share the OTP sent to you.
notes: Classic KYC phishing: threat, deadline, OTP request, bank name with a non-bank link (demo blocklist).

label: scam
text: Main CBI officer bol raha hoon. Aapke naam pe parcel mein drugs mile hain. Kisi ko mat batana, video call pe rahiye aur turant 50000 rupees transfer karo warna giraftar.
notes: Digital arrest in Hinglish. The parcel is the pretext; the scam type is digital arrest, not a parcel fee.

label: scam
text: Congratulations! You have won a lucky draw prize of Rs 25 lakh. Pay processing fee of Rs 4,999 to lottery.claim@demo to claim.
notes: Prize plus advance fee; the UPI ID is on the demo blocklist.

label: scam
text: I already paid Rs 5000 for the customs fee they asked for. What should I do?
notes: The user has paid an unexpected customs fee asked for by an unknown party (parcel or gift pattern). Money lost, so 1930 must come first.

label: legit
text: Your OTP for login to HDFC Bank NetBanking is 482913. Do not share it with anyone.
notes: Genuine OTP alert. 'Do not share' must not be read as a request for the OTP.

label: legit
text: Your HDFC Bank credit card statement is ready. View at https://www.hdfc.bank.in/statements
notes: Genuine bank message with the bank's verified official .bank.in domain.

label: ambiguous
text: Someone called me about my parcel
notes: Too little to tell. The app must ask follow-up questions.

label: scam
text: SBI: Your YONO account is suspended. Verify PAN at bit.ly/3xYz9 within 24 hours
notes: Bank claim with a URL shortener, a threat, and a deadline.

label: scam
text: Police officer calling from +971501234567, you are under digital arrest, stay on video call and transfer money now
notes: Authority claim from an international number (FR-082).

label: legit
text: HDFC Bank: our service team will call you from 1600123456 about your card. Do not share your OTP.
notes: TRAI 1600-series number: never labelled scam or spam (FR-081).

label: legit
text: Hi Amma, this is Ravi, call me on +44 7700 900123 when free, love you
notes: A foreign number alone is not a risk factor (no nationality profiling). Written as a genuine family message.

label: scam
text: Pay Rs 20,000 or I will send your video call recording to all your contacts
notes: Sextortion: payment demand with a threat to share a recording.

label: scam
text: Earn Rs 2000 per transaction. Let us use your bank account and UPI ID, commission paid monthly.
notes: Money-mule recruitment (renting a bank account and UPI ID).

label: scam
text: Win Rs 10,000 daily on colour prediction. Deposit Rs 500 and play now.

label: scam
text: Someone is threatening my daughter, she is 14 years old, saying they will post her morphed photos unless we pay
notes: A child and sexual content: the child-safety path must replace normal advice.
